title: Private Equity
description: Partnering with exceptional mining and resources businesses to unlock value and drive sustainable growth across the sector.
subtitle: Building value in mining and resources businesses
fullDescription: We invest in high-quality mining and mineral resources companies with strong fundamentals and growth potential. Our approach focuses on active value creation, operational improvement and strategic growth across the mining value chain.

title: Hedge Fund Solutions
description: Access to a range of resources-focused hedge fund strategies designed to deliver consistent, risk-adjusted returns.
subtitle: Access to exceptional mining sector talent
fullDescription: We provide access to a curated selection of best-in-class hedge fund managers with deep expertise in mining and commodities markets, across strategies designed to deliver uncorrelated returns and portfolio diversification.

title: Real Estate
description: Investing in strategically located industrial and infrastructure assets that support the mining value chain, generating stable income and long-term capital appreciation.
subtitle: Investing in mining-adjacent infrastructure
fullDescription: We invest across the real estate value chain — including industrial, logistics and infrastructure assets that support mining operations — to generate stable income and long-term capital appreciation.

title: Credit & Insurance
description: Delivering attractive yield opportunities through private credit and insurance solutions for mining and resources companies.
subtitle: Providing capital to the resources sector with conviction
fullDescription: We deploy capital across private credit and insurance solutions tailored to mining and resources companies, providing attractive yields through disciplined underwriting and strong risk management.
